_comment: INTERNAL/dev-only model switcher (D-016). Copy to dev-endpoints.json (gitignored), point DEV_LLM_REGISTRY_FILE at it, run APP_ENV=dev. List ALTERNATIVES to switch to — the configured default endpoint (LLM_BASE_URL) is always offered automatically as 'Standard', so don't repeat it here. Keys are referenced by ENV-VAR NAME (api_key_env) and read from the process env — never inline a key; an entry whose api_key_env is unset/empty is dropped. `label` is the only user-visible string: keep it brand-safe (no engine/provider names). `native_reasoning` drives the Thinking pane (true = stream native reasoning; false = two-pass fallback).
